{{Version|2.2.23}}

[[File:Cards_Button.png|frameless|left]]
Cards are unlocked at Obelisk Level 15 and give perks according to the type of card.

There is a card for every [[Ores|ore]], [[Craft#Crafting_Bars|bar]], [[Bombs#Bombs|bomb]], [[Drones|drone]], [[Pets|pet]], [[Construct#Veins|vein]], and [[Stargazing|star]] in the game, as well as misc cards and cards for [[Archaeology|archaeology]], [[Fishing|fishing]], and [[Arcanist|arcanist]].
{{Clear|left}}

==How to get cards== 
Cards for resources (ores, bars, veins, stars, fish) are obtained by collecting the resource. For example, ore cards are obtained by mining ores, and star cards are obtained by catching stars. Other cards are obtained generally by interacting with the thing the card is for: Bomb cards are obtained by firing [[bombs]], Drone cards are obtained when the drone consumes [[Drones#Drone Fuel|drone fuel]] time, Pet cards are obtained by leveling [[pets]], and Archaeology block cards are obtained by breaking those blocks. Bar cards can be obtained either by crafting bars, or by getting them via the [[Bombs#tabber-Transmuter_Bomb|Transmuter Bomb]]. Legendary Fish cards are guaranteed upon catching the [[Fishing#Legendary_Fish|Legendary Fish]]. Misc cards are obtained by performing miscellaneous actions. See [[Cards#Misc card odds|below]].

Card odds are additive within a single action. That is, if one action should roll for a card multiple times, the probability is added as many time as necessary. For example, if an ore has a 1/5,000,000 chance to give a card when mined, and you gain 50 ore from mining a single rock (due to multis such as a rainbow floor, etc.), you roll a 50/5,000,000 chance to get the card, rather than rolling a 1/5,000,000 chance 50 separate times. Returning from offline causes a single roll for a given card/shard with additive odds for every action done during the time spent offline. This means offline can be used to achieve a 100% chance, but offline also cannot roll for shards more than once meaning achieving 150% odds for example will only ever result in one shard, see [[Offline#Offline_Drop_Threshold_Behavior|Offline Drop Behavior]].

===Gilded Cards===
As soon as you unlock a standard card, you can gild it to increase its effect. Gilding costs Prestige Points, Gold and Gems. See [[Cards#Gilded Card Costs]] for specific prices. Gilded Cards count as a new card in the [[Stats|Stats]] menu and for bonuses based on the number of Cards owned.

===Polychrome Cards===
You can Polychrome your Cards after buying "[[Skill-Tree#Skills|This Is Gonna Take A While..]]" for 40 skill points in the [[Skill-Tree]] and then collecting 10 Polychrome Shards. Polychrome Shards are earned the same way as Cards. To earn Polychrome Shards for a Card, the Card needs to be Gilded first. Polychromed Cards also count as a new Card in the [[Stats|Stats]] menu and for bonuses based on number of Cards owned. The table shows base bonuses and maximally upgraded bonuses where applicable.

===Infernal Cards===
You can Ignite your Cards into Infernal Cards. You have to unlock each set individually. Once a set is unlocked, similar to Polychrome Cards, you must collect 10 Infernal Shards. Infernal cards also count as a new Card in the [[Stats|Stats]] menu and for bonuses based on the number of Cards owned. Certain card sets require [[Skill-Tree|specific skills]] to unlock like [[Skill-Tree#FlamingVeins|Flaming Veins]] to unlock Infernal Vein Cards or [[Skill-Tree#AstralForge|Astral Forge]] to unlock Infernal Star Cards. Infernal Card effects scale based on the total number of Infernal Cards owned and the number of Infernal Cards owned in the same set.

====Infernal Cards Multiplier====
The Infernal card multiplier (with the exception of legendary fish cards) is calculated by the following formula:

<math>\text{Total Multiplier} = 1 + [(\text{PolyBonus} - 1) \times \text{InfernalBonus}]</math><ref name=PolyBonus>If the card's infernal effect is not the same as its poly effect, use the base bonus found [[Cards#Card_Effects|here]] in place of the poly bonus </ref>

For Legendary Fish the formula is instead <math>\text{Total Multiplier} = \text{PolyBonus} \times \text{InfernalBonus}</math>

For example: If a card's polychrome bonus is 1.25x and the infernal multiplier for that card category is 10x, then the Total Multiplier is 3.5x.

The card category infernal multiplier can be worked out with the following formula:

<math>\text{Total Bonus} = [1 + (\text{Inf Card Type Amount} \times \text{Inf Card Type Bonus})</math><math>+</math><math>(\text{All Inf Cards Amount}  \times \text{All Inf Bonus})]\times \text{Other Sources}</math>

For example, having 86 Ore inf cards owned, a total of 356 inf cards owned, and an Other Source bonus of 1.6878x, the formula would be:
<math>\text{Total Bonus} = [1 + (\text{86} \times \text{0.12}) + (\text{356}  \times \text{0.02})]\times \text{1.6878} = \text{31.12x}</math>

==Drone card odds==
All drone cards have a chance to drop for every second they are fueled.<ref>Game speed affects this - with a game speed of 2.00, the card has a chance to drop every 0.5 seconds.</ref><ref>on fuel depletion floors in World 4, the chance doubles to two, as fuel is consumed at twice the speed.</ref>

==Pet card odds==
<section begin="pet-odds-text" />
Pet cards are rolled for when the pet levels up. There is a <math>1/(12-\text{petLevel})</math> chance to get the card. If the pet reaches the max level before you get the card, you continue to roll for the card at the chance for the pet's next level. You can see this chance on the pet in the Pets menu. The chance to get a Polychrome Shard when a pet levels is 100%, however Infernal Shards are rolled completely separately to levels and levelling does not give an Infernal Shard. Refer to [[Pets#Leveling|Levelling section of the Pets page]] for pet level chances.<section end="pet-odds-text" />

==Misc card odds==
{{See also|Guides/Cards}}
Misc cards are unlocked randomly by performing specific action(s) or meeting specific condition(s). Note that, except the CODE card/Polychrome shards and RELIC Polychrome shards, none of the misc cards are guaranteed to be unlocked as obtaining them is chance based. Some [[Cards#tabber-Infernal|infernal Misc cards]] have a different unlocking method for infernal shards compared to their Standard and Polychrome variants. These cards are denoted by a 🔥.
